mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_test_runs (id, environment, collection_id, total, passed, failed, blocked, skipped, duration_ms, ok, message, trigger_type, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{environment}, #{collectionId}, #{total}, #{passed}, #{failed}, #{blocked}, #{skipped}, #{durationMs}, #{ok}, #{message}, #{triggerType}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO api_test_run_cases (id, run_id, case_id, name, method, path, url, status, http_status, duration_ms, error, case_kind, intent, expect_note, assertion_results, body_preview, req_headers, req_body, resp_headers, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{runId}, #{caseId}, #{name}, #{method}, #{path}, #{url}, #{status}, #{httpStatus}, #{durationMs}, #{error}, #{caseKind}, #{intent}, #{expectNote}, #{assertionResults}, #{bodyPreview}, #{reqHeaders}, #{reqBody}, #{respHeaders}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT case_kind AS caseKind, COUNT(1) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'BLOCKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blocked FROM api_test_run_cases WHERE run_id = #{runId} GROUP BY case_kind

SELECT id, run_id AS runId, case_id AS caseId, name, method, path, url, status, http_status AS httpStatus, duration_ms AS durationMs, error, created_at AS createdAt FROM api_test_run_cases ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM api_test_cases WHERE created_at >= #{since}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'BLOCKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blocked, AVG(duration_ms) AS avgLatencyMs FROM api_test_run_cases WHERE created_at >= #{since}
AND created_at < #{until}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.project), ''), '(未分组)') AS project, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS caseCount, COUNT(r.id) AS runCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'BLOCKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blocked FROM api_test_cases c LEFT JOIN api_test_run_cases r ON r.case_id = c.id AND r.created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.project), ''), '(未分组)') ORDER BY caseCount DESC, project ASC

SELECT r.id, r.environment, r.collection_id AS collectionId, c.name AS collectionName, c.project AS collectionProject, c.requirement_no AS requirementNo, c.source_branch AS sourceBranch, c.scope AS collectionScope, r.total, r.passed, r.failed, r.blocked, r.skipped, r.duration_ms AS durationMs, r.ok, r.message, r.trigger_type AS triggerType, r.created_by AS createdBy, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM api_test_runs r LEFT JOIN api_test_collections c ON c.id = r.collection_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT rc.run_id AS runId, NULLIF(TRIM(tc.project), '') AS caseProject, NULLIF(TRIM(col.project), '') AS collectionProject, rc.method AS method, rc.path AS path, COUNT(1) AS caseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rc.status IN ('PASSED', 'BLOCKED') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS failedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rc.status = 'BLOCKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blockedCount, MAX(CASE WHEN rc.status = 'PASSED' THEN NULL ELSE rc.error END) AS error, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rc.status = 'PASSED' THEN NULL ELSE rc.http_status END), MAX(rc.http_status)) AS httpStatus FROM api_test_run_cases rc LEFT JOIN api_test_cases tc ON tc.id = rc.case_id LEFT JOIN api_test_runs r ON r.id = rc.run_id LEFT JOIN api_test_collections col ON col.id = r.collection_id WHERE rc.path IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(rc.path) != '' AND TRIM(rc.path) NOT IN ('(未识别接口)', '—') GROUP BY rc.run_id, rc.method, rc.path, NULLIF(TRIM(tc.project), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(col.project), '')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM api_test_run_cases WHERE run_id IN #{id}
DELETE FROM api_test_runs WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.environment, r.collection_id AS collectionId, r.total, r.passed, r.failed, r.blocked, r.skipped, r.duration_ms AS durationMs, r.ok, r.message, r.trigger_type AS triggerType, r.created_by AS createdBy, r.created_at AS createdAt, c.name AS collectionName, CASE WHEN r.collection_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM api_test_runs r2 WHERE r2.collection_id = r.collection_id AND r2.created_at <= r.created_at) END AS seqNo FROM api_test_runs r LEFT JOIN api_test_collections c ON c.id = r.collection_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT id, run_id AS runId, case_id AS caseId, name, method, path, url, status, http_status AS httpStatus, duration_ms AS durationMs, error, intent, expect_note AS expectNote, assertion_results AS assertionResults, body_preview AS bodyPreview, req_headers AS reqHeaders, req_body AS reqBody, resp_headers AS respHeaders, created_at AS createdAt FROM api_test_run_cases WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY (status = 'PASSED') ASC, created_at ASC

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, COUNT(1) AS runs, SUM(total) AS total, SUM(passed) AS passed, SUM(failed) AS failed FROM api_test_runs WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY day ASC
